svg.text: claudia — importing a file: asking for description and tags, proposed
The "Open a file" dialog as built (ImportDialog.vue, D438–D442) with two new optional fields. The same dialog opens for a file chosen with Open a File… and for one dropped anywhere on the page.
What the file already says about itself is offered as a starting point; nothing is required.
A · Importing an Excel file, as the dialog is built plus two fields
The fields sit between Name and the person's own name and password; everything else is unchanged.
Claudia makes a table of it, and the file goes into the new document with it, sealed.
The file on this computer stays as it is.
Draft budget from the finance team,
Keep the Excel file inside the document: Download then gives back this file with only your changes.
You are its owner. What the document does not show stays in the kept file and is listed after it opens.
B · The two fields in other situations
Left unfilled it is fine: the document simply has no description and no tags yet.
The file carries nothing (or it is a text file with no properties)
What is this document for? Others see this in the list.
Markdown. Shown in the list to everybody who can see This computer, also without a password.
C · A Claudia file already has them
A sealed Claudia document goes in as it is (D438); its description and tags are in the plain manifest.
A Claudia document goes into a place as it is, still sealed, and is opened with a name and
They come with the file and cannot be changed here — use Details… after it is in.
D · The same fields in the file formats (import reads them, Download writes them back)
Proposal; so that a file leaves Claudia the way it came in, and the description is not lost on the way (D145: export content only — this is metadata, not content).
On import, if the file has none
Description and tags are asked for on every import, but both optional: a person who just wants to look at
a file presses Open. Claudia never makes up a description; the AI may be asked to draft one from the content
later (a suggestion to accept, like every AI change here).
Tags offer the tags already used on the place (with counts), so the vocabulary converges instead of
drifting into "finance", "Finance" and "finances". Comparison ignores case; a new tag is added with Enter.
Taken from the file's own properties when present, and marked as such, so it is clear where the text
came from. Nothing is sent anywhere before Open: the page only fills the fields.
The suggestions come from this place only (a page talks only to its own server, D170): tags of other
places are not visible from here, and need not be.
A Claudia file keeps what its owner wrote. It is shown read-only so the person sees what the place will
now show about the document; she can change it afterwards with Details… if she is the owner.
The unencrypted import path (D108, E2.9) needs the same two fields; the table is the proposed mapping,
to be confirmed against the readers and writers in claudia-opc-io and claudia-odf-io before it is built.
